subject.title: fix(ai): record token usage on Responses early-abort (#100954)

question: After the duplicate helper is consolidated, should this external PR remain blocked for a real OpenAI or Azure `response.incomplete` run, or receive a maintainer proof override based on exact-event tests?
rationale: Repository policy requires after-fix real behavior proof for external PRs, and the dependency example permits null usage while the linked issue names cancellation paths that the tests do not exercise.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted terminal output or logs show nonzero usage and cost on an actual incomplete OpenAI or Azure response.

options.title: Approve a narrow override
options.body: Accept the exact-event tests only after narrowing the PR claim to server-emitted incomplete responses and explicitly leaving cancellation or timeout behavior unresolved.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted terminal output or logs show nonzero usage and cost on an actual incomplete OpenAI or Azure response.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer and the contributor has explicitly directed the live-proof versus override choice to them.
